notes.title: One Year Anniversary Update With NEW CARDS!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! It's been one year since Recesses released, and I'm still amazed by the response you all have given it. 

Getting to Very Positive on Steam was something I'd never thought possible (I figured I'd get 2 negative ratings and tumbleweeds), so thank you to everyone who has helped it get there!

As a small celebration of the one year anniversary, I've prepared a little content update for the game by adding four new cards (plus a few other things). If you want a breakdown of the updates, then read on. And if not... then don't!

[b]To confirm you're playing on the latest Version 1.1, go to Game Options and check the upper left corner. If it's a lower version, just restart Steam and it should update automatically.[/b]

Each of the new cards added in this update is a "captain," with an ability that triggers *inside* of the spaceship. And here's all four of them:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ODKRMAD.png[/img]

All of the captains were designed to help strategies that I felt could use a little boost. If you want to explore them on your own, go for it! But if you want more details on the thought process behind them, here's some details on each card.

[b](There are some spoilers for other rare cards in the explanations, so it's recommended not to read those if you haven't finished the game yet.)[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/OeP4QHE.png[/img]
- Created to boost Battaliens with big weaknesses, particularly the [spoiler]Essences, turning them into 8-power monstrosities.[/spoiler]
- Another goal was to make synergy cards like Puuts Admirer and Tel-maq Resonator stronger if they lost their ability. 
- Now if your Puuts Admirer gets [spoiler]Ossh'am-ed, you can give it +4 power and take down that Ossh'am[/spoiler] in battle!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/sJCtTaR.png[/img]
- Created to boost "sacrifice" synergy spaceships, which were fun and strong but also fragile.
- Can also help players struggling against [spoiler]Elders: just sacrifice something that negates an ability when it dies, and that'll help even the playing field.[/spoiler]
- Lots of fun cobbling together a win after getting a bunch of random Gross commons. It's Brepch Sogworm and Lethoggl Doozer's time to shine!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/YxrhbSt.png[/img]
- Created to boost win-ability synergy spaceships in a way that's not just increasing the win-ability Battaliens' power.
- Another goal was to give mono-Scary a way to work with win-ability Battaliens like Sevir Intimidator and Ignix Fearfire.
- Has the potential to be the most dangerous of the Captains combo-wise, but where's the fun without a little danger??

[img]https://i.imgur.com/QTHgZWk.png[/img]
- Created to boost the "beefy dudes" spaceship. The ability your 9-power card gets can be a "before damage" one, a "dies" one if it's going to die, or a "wins" one if it's going to win.
- Another goal was to help boost [spoiler]Elder ships, since Cnyr7w Captain will always give an Elder Battalien a random Elder ability.[/spoiler]
- Can be used *against* [spoiler]Elders too: if an enemy Elder took your ability/power away, now you can get a new ability to whack back at it![/spoiler]

The Captains can be obtained normally as you progress through the game. To find out how to specifically obtain them, click/hover over the spoiler below.

[spoiler]You can open Captains in booster packs after encountering Emily. They appear at the same rarity as normal rare cards.

If you don't want to wait, there are cheat codes to add each one to your collection. To enter a cheat code, go to the main menu, press enter, then type the code, then press enter again. If you hear a sound effect, you did it right and the card is in your collection.
- To get Katsi Captain, enter the cheat code "doesyourshiphavetuna" 
- To get Phlek Captain, enter the cheat code "thiscardissick"
- To get Kahaz Captain, enter the cheat code "leadingfromtheshadows"
- To get Cnyr7w Captain, enter the cheat code "chargedupandincharge"[/spoiler]

Since it wouldn't be fair if only *you* got to use the Captains in battle, I've added Captains to some of the opponents' ships throughout the game. 

I've only added Captains to ships that already changed each time you faced them (opponents with non-changing ships did not get them), and they only use their Captain ships about 25% of the time. To see where, click/hover over the spoiler below:

[b](Spoilers for late game battles are included too, so it's recommended not to read if you haven't finished the game yet.)[/b]

[spoiler]- Level 1 Emily can have any one of the four Captains
- Level 1 Ms. Raven can have Phlek Captain, Kahaz Captain, or Cnyr7w Captain
- Level 2 Eugene can have Katsi Captain or Kahaz Captain
- Level 2 Tatiana can have Phlek Captain or Cnyr7w Captain
- Level 2 Mr. Whittier can have Katsi Captain
- Level 3 Joey/Wires can have any one of the four Captains
- Level 3 Goatee can have Cnyr7w Captain[/spoiler]

...and there may be one more secret captain somewhere too, hehe.

A few other small updates to the game:

- [b]Brepch Skinshedder[/b] had its two -2 weaknesses changed to two -9 weakness to, ironically, make it stronger.

- [b]Lethoggl Blobbuddy[/b] had its two -4 weaknesses changed to two -8 weaknesses to synergize with Brepch Skinshedder without changing the card's power significantly.

- [b]Tel-maq Symmetree[/b] now has a +2 strength to Scary, increased from +1, to bring it in line with multi-turn-play cards like Oowoo Cozycoach and Puuts Peptalker.

- [b]Ob'itzan Glarer[/b] now has 7 power, increased from 6, to bring it in line with niche cards like Sevir Screamer and cards with dies abilities like Phlek Parasite.

Finally, two new pieces of art that are not spoilers on their own, but the explanations of the battle where you encounter them are.
[spoiler]- Metl now transforms the enemy Battalien into this image when using its first "Useless Rock" ability (art by Junkyard Dawg who did the other Butt-aliens card art):[/spoiler]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/aGCY1CB.png[/img]

[spoiler]- Metl now transforms the enemy Battalien into this image when using its third "Technological Consciousness" ability:[/spoiler]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/NGcS3dL.png[/img]

I've playtested the changes as much as I can, but I'm sure I've missed some stuff. If you run into any bugs or have any other questions/comments, let me know in the Steam forums.

Thank you again for playing!
-Sanjuny

notes.title: Small Updates for Version 1.07
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! It's been a while, but thank you for still taking the time to check out Recesses.

The new version 1.07 of the game has made a few small changes:

- In battle and in the collection screen, when you can click on a card, the mouse cursor will turn to a finger when hovering over that card, and the card will get a yellow outline. This should hopefully make it easier to see when you can/can't choose certain cards for sending them out, choosing for abilities, etc.
- A few fixed graphical mistakes
- A few fixed spelling/grammar mistakes in dialogue sections
- A few lines of dialogue tweaked for better understanding

[b]To confirm you're playing on the latest Version 1.07, go to Game Options and check the upper left corner. If it's a lower version, just restart Steam and it should update automatically.[/b]

As always if you have suggestions feel free to let me know.

Thank you again for playing!
-Sanjuny

notes.title: Updates for Version 1.06
notes.notes:
Hello, and thank you for playing my little game Recesses!

The new version 1.06 update of the game has a few additions and bug fixes:

ADDITIONS
- Eight new Steam achievements have been added to the game. 
- Seven of them are for collecting certain amounts of total cards (100, 256, 500, etc) to give some value to opening dozens and dozens of duplicates. You can also now see your total number of cards opened in the collection screen, at the bottom of the black text box in the upper left. The game checks for achievements whenever you open a booster pack.
- The other achievement is Goat.
- There is now popup text/sound effect for when you have 8 saved spaceships with all different cards in them
- [spoiler]The wording on Metl's ability has changed from "turn" to "transform" and now the cards affected by its "transform" abilities slightly change color too, to make it more clear what's happening.[/spoiler]

BUG FIXES
- Added a very short delay between removing a card from your ship and then being able to remove another card, to prevent misclicks
- [spoiler]Made it so you shouldn't see the encouragement scene for Tatiana's four-card challenge multiple times in a row when rematching her.[/spoiler]
- [spoiler]Made it so Ignix Erupter interacts correctly against the Disillusioner card.[/spoiler]
- [spoiler]Fixed a softlock when you somehow *only* have 2 active Metls in your spaceship at the same time. Note: this should not be possible![/spoiler]

[b]To confirm you're playing on the latest Version 1.06, go to Game Options and check the upper left corner. If it's a lower version, just restart Steam and it should update automatically.[/b]

I've been having a great time reading about all of your experiences with the game in the discussion board and in the reviews. I really appreciate you taking a chance on an unknown game like this! I'm still looking into the feasibility of a few more small changes to the game, but as always if you have suggestions feel free to let me know.

Thank you again for playing!
-Sanjuny

notes.title: Small Version 1.05 Update
notes.notes:
Hello, and thank you for taking a chance on Recesses!

The new version 1.05 update of the game has a few small requested updates:

* You can now toggle skip/show Soup or Nova coinflips in Game Options. If you skip coinflips, then when 2 (or more) abilities happen at the same time, one will just be chosen at random.
* You can now adjust the game volume AND toggle skip/show coinflips in the ESC menu during a run.

[b]To confirm you're playing on the latest Version 1.05, go to Game Options and check the upper left corner. If it's a lower version, just restart Steam and it should update automatically.[/b]

As always, I'm looking into the feasibility of a few other quality of life updates to the game. If there's anything you'd like to see added, feel free to post in the Discussion sections. I can't promise that I can put everything in, but I can at least check it out.

Thank you again for playing!
-Sanjuny

notes.title: Update Notes for Version 1.04
notes.notes:
Hello, and thank you for checking out Recesses!

Apologies for this being the third update in a little over a week since release, but I appreciate everyone letting me know bugs they run into while playing. I've tried to patch them up as quickly as I can.

The new version 1.04 brings with it these changes:

* Card images have been added during dialogue sections when characters talk about certain cards, so that you can see them then and there.
* You can now press "T" again to toggle OFF auto-skip after it's been enabled.
* Booster packs now hide in the collection when you're filtering the cards (except when filtering by default/new), making seeing cards easier when you have a lot of booster packs.
* Fixed a bug where strength/weakness calculation would be incorrect if the enemy Battalien has a strength AND weakness to your type AND a power limit too
* Fixed a bug where clicking Suggest Ship during an empty collection run after you opened an [spoiler]Elder God[/spoiler] could cause collection issues
* Fixed a bug where Eugene's last hint could crash the game in some circumstances. (His knowledge is too powerful??)

[b]To confirm you're playing on the latest Version 1.04, go to Game Options and check the upper left corner. If it's a lower version, just restart Steam and it should update automatically.[/b]

I'm still looking into the feasibility of adding a few quality of life features to the game, and as always I'm open to any feedback, so if you have any thoughts, feel free to post in the Discussion sections.

Thank you again for playing!
-Sanjuny

notes.title: Version 1.03 Update
notes.notes:
Hello, and thank you for taking a chance on my game Recesses!

Since release day a week ago, a lot of players have reported game crashes when using the "T" ("thkip") auto-skip feature during dialogue sections of the game. In order to fix that, I've updated the visual novel plugin I'm using (Dialogic) to the latest version, which should hopefully take care of that.

Updating Dialogic brought with it a bunch more bugs that I had to fix. I've patched them up as I found them while playing, but I'm just one dev, so if you have any new issues or if the auto-skip crash persists for you, please let me know and I will do my best to fix them.

[b]To confirm you're playing on the latest Version 1.03, you can go to Game Options and check the upper left corner. If it's a lower version, just restart Steam and it should update automatically.[/b]

Along with that update, Version 1.03 has a few other small changes:

* In order to prevent accidental quits, pressing ESC twice no longer automatically quits a run. You have to press ESC then click the quit button to actually quit.
* I've added in a few more hints about the "T" auto-skip feature so that hopefully players who want to use it don't miss it.
* Fixed a bug that could softlock the game if your last card was an [spoiler]Elder God[/spoiler] that gained control of the opponent's [spoiler]Elder God[/spoiler].
* Fixed bug where opening a booster pack with an empty ship would sometimes automatically put the first card in that pack into your ship.

I'm looking to add a few new quality of life features to the game over the next week or so. I'm always open to feedback and chat, so if you have any thoughts or made any cool plays you want to tell me about, feel free to post in the Discussion sections.

Thanks again for playing!
-Sanjuny

notes.title: Hotfix for Version 1.02
notes.notes:
Hello! Thank you all for playing Recesses. It's been a lot of fun hearing about your experiences with it :)

I've heard from some players that the game crashed during dialogue sections while they were holding down Space/Enter to progress the text. I'm not exactly sure what was causing that crash, but until it's fixed, I've updated the game to not progress the text as fast in dialogue sections when holding down Space/Enter. In my testing, this has prevented crashes, but please let me know if they continue for you.

You can make sure you're playing Version 1.02 by going into Game Options and checking the upper left. Just restart Steam to update it if you need to.

[b]And if you want to progress through the dialogue section text quickly, you can still press the "T" key ("T" for "Thkip!") which in my testing does not cause crashes.[/b]

Apologies for any inconveniences, and thank you again for taking a chance on my game!
